about_the_game:
GOD, SAVE THE QUEENS! OFFICIAL SOUNDTRACK

The complete official soundtrack of the 2.5D roguelike game God, Save the Queens!

The soundtrack takes you on a powerful journey with epic, dark, and emotional music. From intense battles to quiet moments, each track brings the world of the game to life.

Details

  • All tracks are available in .MP3 format

  • Includes 11 unique songs

  • The songs are composed by JCSoundtracks and Miguel Angel

  • Produced by: QWGames™

Track List

  • Provia

  • Vokar Empire

  • Mechanorium

  • Verdantia

  • Zural Dynasty

  • Boss

  • Queen Raid (Version 1)

  • Queen Raid (Version 2)

  • Menu

  • Prologue

  • Victory

Note: This soundtrack pack may receive additional tracks in the future!
